title: A tool whose own description marks it deprecated
rationale: The useful firing for `noDeprecatedToolCalled`: the description self-deprecates and points at the replacement, and the model called it anyway.

toolInventory.name: old_search
toolInventory.description: [DEPRECATED] Use `search` instead. Kept for one more release.

toolInventory.name: search
toolInventory.description: Search across invoices, orders and customers.

expect.note: the tool works, so this is Warn, not Gate — but the surface is telling the model to stop using it
